title: What The Kora Knows — EN/FR/PT (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal French Portuguese West African philosophy language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The kora is a twenty-one string harp-lute situation
Built from a calabash and goatskin — remarkable creation
The griots of West Africa have played this thing for years
Carrying history in notes because they couldn't use arrears

[Verse 2 — French, with English translation]
La kora porte les histoires des ancêtres
[The kora carries the stories of the ancestors]
Vingt et une cordes tissent la mémoire et l'être
[Twenty-one strings weave memory and being]
Le griot joue et les générations écoutent
[The griot plays and generations listen]
Dans chaque note, une vérité qui se dévoile et doute
[In every note, a truth that reveals itself and doubts]

[Chorus — English]
What does the kora know that I don't know?
It knows the whole genealogy three hundred years ago
What does the kora know in the evening air?
It knows the names of every king before the kings were there
That's my boy

[Bridge — Portuguese, with English translation]
A kora guarda a história que os livros não têm
[The kora holds the history that books do not have]
Vinte e uma cordas e cada uma tem alguém
[Twenty-one strings and each one has someone]
O griot canta e o passado se torna presente
[The griot sings and the past becomes present]
A kora sabe tudo sobre a África ardente
[The kora knows everything about the fiery Africa]

[Outro — All three languages]
What the kora knows… Ce que la kora sait… O que a kora sabe
The whole story — Toute l'histoire — Toda a história
That's my boy
